_what_this_is: Accept threshold tau for scripts/autoresearch_agent.py, in the field layout that script's load_tau() expects. NOT a new measurement: every number here is copied from measurement/INSTRUMENT_CALIBRATION.json, which is the single source.
_why_this_file_exists: autoresearch_agent.py requires --tau-file and falls back to a hardcoded 0.02656 when it is absent. That fallback number appears in no pre-registration, so running without this file would make every keep decision against a threshold nobody registered. Rule 1 requires the threshold to be fixed before the loop starts, not invented by a default.

_field_semantics.tau_pp: ACCEPTANCE CONTRACT. load_tau() reads this field and divides by 100, so it must be in PERCENTAGE POINTS. The source stores 4.95 as a rounded display value; the exact figure is recovered from the stored proportion so no precision is lost in the conversion.
_field_semantics.value: the same threshold as a proportion, copied for readability. Not read by load_tau().

use_for: a selection decision made on the 120-case dev split, Bonferroni-corrected over a horizon of 1000 decisions
not_for: decisions on the frozen test split use tau_test (3.11 pp); this file is the dev-split threshold and must not be reused for a Rule-1 success claim.
provenance_chain: floor_B_run_to_run: SD 0.40 pp over 5 replicates (a property of this training path)
floor_A_measurement_sampling: SE 1.0668 pp, case-level cluster bootstrap over 400 cases
combined and Bonferroni-corrected over a horizon of 1000 selection decisions -> 4.95 pp
